analysis: The code snippet contains a loop that iterates over the keys of `new_pts` using an iterator. The call to `next()` is made inside the loop body immediately after the loop condition `it.hasNext()` is checked. The loop structure ensures that `next()` is only called when `hasNext()` returns true, which guarantees that there is at least one element available.
